summary: Milestone 4 verification: 'Paragraph Purpose' canonical domain enriched to the ~31-field schema (matching Opening/Introduction and Central Claim/Thesis); engine code UNCHANGED (still uses the generic section-level retrieval + two-stage domain/section selector from M3). Backend pytest 14/14 pass on new /app/backend/tests/test_milestone4_paragraph.py (record shape + observable_organizations count + other-domains-untouched + 4-turn Paragraph Purpose flow + narrative & reflective genre sensitivity + section-level log/prompt-size bounded + validation regression + section-filter unit) — 202s. Full M1+M2+M3 regression 30/30 pass on the existing test_developmental_engine.py + test_milestone2_opening.py + test_milestone3_thesis.py suite — 456s. Combined 44/44 pass against the public URL (https://dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com). Paragraph Purpose reasoning verified end-to-end: a topic-listing body paragraph for an argumentative essay surfaces 'Paragraph Purpose' in theory.currently_relevant_domains alongside 'Central Claim / Thesis'; the invitation asks the student to name the paragraph's job WITHOUT rewriting it, WITHOUT demanding a first-sentence topic sentence, and WITHOUT forcing claim-evidence-analysis; alternative_interpretations remains populated; theory_history grows v1..v4 across a 4-turn session (writing -> revise -> answer -> revise) each under 60s. Genre sensitivity holds: a narrative paragraph is NOT pushed into 'state your claim / add evidence / analyze it' language, and a reflective paragraph's uncertainty is not forced to resolve. Section-level retrieval remains bounded even with THREE enriched domains: recent backend log samples show reasoner_prompt_bytes 10.7-17.6KB with 4-6 sections per selected domain (versus the ~50KB whole-13-domain dump). Frontend Playwright via public URL: TeacherSetup (input-assignment/input-pedagogical_purpose/input-current_writing_task) -> begin-session-button -> StudentWorkspace (writing-area + continue-button) -> SSE ai-invitation rendered -> open-dev-panel-button -> development-panel shows 'CURRENTLY RELEVANT CANONICAL DOMAINS: Central Claim / Thesis, Paragraph Purpose', ACTIVE TENSION(S), Alternative Interpretations, candidate-invitation-0/1 cards, selected-invitation; toggle-telos-editor -> telos-edit-current_writing_task -> save-telos-button (verified in prior M3 iteration).

minor.issue: Still returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (carried over from prior iterations, non-blocking).

reasoner_prompt_bytes hits ~17.6KB whenever BOTH Opening/Introduction AND Central Claim/Thesis are selected in the same turn (their enrichments overlap). Paragraph Purpose alone with a lightweight partner stays ~11-12KB. Not a functional bug; noted for future capacity planning if more domains get enriched.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking reply-mode-revise switches the LEFT writing-area into 'Send revised draft' mode; typing into reply-input on the right does not trigger revise submission (send-reply-button is only wired for 'answer'/'explain' modes). This is expected UX per StudentWorkspace.jsx design (revise updates the draft on the left), but the reply-input remains visually editable while the mode is 'revise' which can mislead automated tests. Not an M4 regression; noted so future Playwright scripts use writing-area + continue-button for revise, not reply-input + send-reply-button.

issues: Carried over from prior iterations (non-blocking): the sliding dev panel (max-w-md, fixed right-0) overlays the sticky 'Conversation with your coach' column rather than being offset.

action_items: None blocking. Milestone 4 acceptance criteria met end-to-end.
Optional (carry-over): offset dev panel so it doesn't overlay sticky conversation column at wide viewports.

Optional: if a fourth domain gets enriched to the ~31-field schema, keep an eye on turns where 3+ enriched domains co-occur — current M4 test file has a 32KB ceiling; may want to cap sections per domain in _select_relevant_domains to keep the median down.
critical_code_review_comments: canonical_writing_model.json — Paragraph Purpose enriched to 31 keys (domain_status, governing/possible_communicative_functions, observable_organizations A-V with 22 entries, possible_differentiations/integrations/coordinations, common_productive_tensions, alternative_interpretations, common_misunderstandings, possible_developmental_movements, candidate_developmental_invitations (14), invitation_construction_rules, relationships_to_other_domains, genre_sensitivity, inside_outside_coordination, prohibitions (13)). Other 10 lightweight domains untouched at 9 keys each; Opening and Thesis untouched at 31 keys each. Verified via test_other_domains_untouched_by_m4.

server.py — DATA-ONLY milestone confirmed: git-diff-free view of server.py shows the SAME two-stage selector + get_relevant_domain_data + ALWAYS_KEYS + _select_relevant_domains + log line '[interact] domains/sections={name:count} reasoner_prompt_bytes=NNNN' from M3. No paragraph-specific branching in the engine. The record-only enrichment is the correct approach per the milestone contract.

test_milestone4_paragraph.py — Adds a THIRD enriched-domain regression suite while sharing the SSE helper shape with M3 (opportunity to hoist sse_interact into conftest.py in a future iteration — flagged in M3 review, still applicable).

Genre sensitivity: the paragraph_purpose genre_sensitivity field in the record is exercised end-to-end via TestGenreSensitivity — narrative + reflective sessions produce invitations that avoid claim-evidence-analysis language. This is the correct semantic test for a DATA-ONLY milestone (the record's content is what shapes the invitation, not code).

Bounded prompt: the M4 ceiling of 32KB in test_recent_prompt_bytes_bounded is a safe alarm — empirical worst case observed is ~17.6KB (Opening + Thesis both selected). The ~50KB whole-13-domain dump would trip the assertion; section-level retrieval is measurably working.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the full backend suite serially: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_developmental_engine.py /app/backend/tests/test_milestone2_opening.py /app/backend/tests/test_milestone3_thesis.py /app/backend/tests/test_milestone4_paragraph.py -v -n 0` (~11 min total because every /interact turn is a live Claude Sonnet 4.6 call). Milestone 4 introduces NO new log format — still `[interact] domains/sections={<name>: <section_count>, ...} reasoner_prompt_bytes=NNNN`. Section-filtered reasoner_prompt_bytes ranges: ~8-12KB when Paragraph Purpose + one lightweight domain is selected; ~13-18KB when TWO of the enriched trio (Opening / Thesis / Paragraph Purpose) co-occur, each still filtered to 4-6 sections. Whole-model payload would be ~50KB. The M4 test file uses a 32KB ceiling and 22KB median; the M3 test file uses a stricter 26KB ceiling and 16KB median which still passes on the current data. TeacherSetup input testids are `input-assignment`, `input-pedagogical_purpose`, `input-current_writing_task`, `input-teacher_notes` (NOT `assignment-input` etc). StudentWorkspace revise flow: clicking reply-mode-revise switches the LEFT writing-area into 'Send revised draft' mode — the RIGHT reply-input + send-reply-button are for 'answer' / 'explain' modes only. Use writing-area + continue-button for a revise submission in Playwright.
